content:
Successfully updated HWPX documents by manipulating section0.xml within the ZIP archive while handling text fragmentation and layout caching.
The process involved concatenating fragmented text across multiple <hp:t> elements within <hp:p> containers and consolidating replacements into the first element. To prevent visual artifacts, <hp:lineSegArray> elements were removed to force layout recalculation. Implementation utilized lxml with the original nsmap for schema navigation and ensured ZIP integrity by preserving non-modified files like mimetype and settings.xml.
